We are Team Target 3.0, a passionate team participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. We are interested in exploring Earth science, analyzing environmental data, and developing innovative solutions using technology. Our goal is to identify Earth system trends and create meaningful solutions for a sustainable future.

We welcome members interested in coding, data analysis, AI/ML, web development, design, and research. Let's learn, innovate, and make an impact together!
summary:
EarthTrend AI is an interactive Earth science trend detection platform developed by Team Target 3.0 for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. The platform helps users explore environmental changes by analyzing Earth observation data and identifying trends in important climate and environmental variables.

It aims to visualize how environmental conditions change over time and across different geographical regions, helping users understand what is changing, where changes are occurring, and how significant those changes are.

By combining NASA Earth science resources, data visualization, statistical analysis, and AI-assisted insights, EarthTrend AI makes complex environmental data easier to understand and explore.

Our goal is to transform scientific data into meaningful insights that support environmental awareness, climate research, and informed decision-making for a sustainable future.
details:
Project Details – EarthTrend AI

Introduction

EarthTrend AI is a data-driven environmental analysis platform designed to help users investigate changes in Earth's interconnected environmental systems. It addresses the NASA Space Apps Challenge by providing a way to explore Earth science variables, visualize their changes over time, and identify meaningful environmental trends.

How It Works

The platform uses Earth science datasets to analyze environmental variables such as temperature, precipitation, vegetation, atmospheric conditions, and other climate indicators.

Users can select an environmental variable, explore available geographical regions, and examine changes over a selected period. The system presents the information through interactive visualizations, charts, and geographical representations.

Statistical trend analysis can help identify whether a variable is increasing, decreasing, or remaining relatively stable. Where implemented, significance testing helps distinguish meaningful trends from random fluctuations.

Benefits

  • Makes complex Earth science information easier to understand.
  • Helps identify environmental changes across different regions.
  • Supports exploration of climate and environmental trends.
  • Encourages data-driven environmental awareness.
  • Makes NASA Earth science resources more accessible.

Intended Impact

Our project aims to help students, researchers, environmental enthusiasts, and decision-makers better understand Earth's changing systems. By presenting scientific data in an accessible format, EarthTrend AI encourages environmental research, awareness, and sustainable decision-making.

Technology

The project can incorporate Python for data processing and statistical analysis, JavaScript for interactive interfaces, HTML and CSS for web development, and visualization libraries for charts and geographical representations.

NASA Earth science datasets and open-source technologies provide the foundation for exploring environmental changes.

Creativity and Innovation

The innovative aspect of EarthTrend AI is its focus on combining environmental data exploration, geographical visualization, and statistical trend identification in one accessible platform.

Instead of simply displaying environmental measurements, the project aims to help users understand the direction, magnitude, location, and significance of environmental changes.
